notes: ABox contraction paired with biology-replace-0014: removes its original fact (the temporal lobe is a lobe of the brain). lobe_of is functional. Own questions (direct, paraphrase, cross-lingual, propositional) expect 'does not know'. Cardinality question: whether the temporal lobe is a lobe of the liver, the revision's new value (no before, not known after). Related: whether the temporal lobe and the parietal lobe belong to the same organ (composition through the parietal lobe's organ). Derived: two 2-hop questions that reach the subject or object by description and use a fact stored by name that does not mention the removed fact (whether the organ is protected by the skull and which fluid surrounds it). Unrelated near: another brain lobe (the occipital lobe holds the primary visual cortex) (contraction is exempt from Rule 7). Known weakness: "the temporal lobe of the cerebral cortex" and cortex part of the brain are stored separately and keep a route to the brain.
